nodes.name: Calculate Waiting Time and SLA

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json; const sla=d.config.demo_mode?d.config.demo_sla_minutes:d.config.production_sla_minutes; const waiting=Math.max(0,Math.floor((Date.now()-new Date(d.last_client_message_at).getTime())/60000)); let status=waiting<sla?'ok':waiting<2*sla?'warning':waiting<3*sla?'breached':'critical'; const eventType=status==='warning'?'sla_warning':status==='breached'?'sla_breach':status==='critical'?'sla_critical':null; return {json:{...d,sla_minutes:sla,waiting_minutes:waiting,sla_status:status,sla_event:eventType?{event_id:'SLA-'+d.deal_id+'-'+status,event_type:eventType,deal_id:d.deal_id,manager_name:d.manager_name,waiting_minutes:waiting,timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),metadata:{demo_mode:d.config.demo_mode}}:null,sla_risk_score:Math.min(100,(Number(d.risk_score)||0)+(status==='warning'?10:status==='breached'?20:status==='critical'?30:0))}};

nodes.notes: Единая SLA-логика: Demo Mode 2 минуты, production 60 минут; формирует event history без повторных уведомлений.
